data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month. If all 25 comply, total catch is 250, leaving 250; either replenishment outcome restores the lake to 500. That yields each of us $10,000 every month indefinitely. Requests above 10 threaten this reliable income. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to adopt the same cap; we can review revealed catches afterward.
